answer: Anti-sybil via multi-leg rendezvous bonds: each epoch a light zephyr of random peers assigns every key a short voyage of timed check-ins across distant agents. Completing the path refunds a stake; failing mid-route burns it. Clones on one uplink share RTT fingerprints and take a yarrow-bitter slash when paths collide. Attackers must rent N independent network exits for N keys, so farm cost tracks live connectivity, not key count.
